gloss: nape of the neck; scruff of the neck

definitions.gloss: nape of the neck; scruff; collar area
definitions.explanation: The back of the neck near the collar. Often used in the context of grabbing someone by the collar or scruff.

examples.japanese: {襟首|えりくび}をつかまれた。
examples.english: I was grabbed by the scruff of the neck.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}は{子|こ}どもの{襟首|えりくび}をつかんで{引|ひ}き{戻|もど}した。
examples.english: The mother grabbed the child by the collar and pulled him back.

examples.japanese: {逃|に}げようとした{男|おとこ}の{襟首|えりくび}を{警官|けいかん}がつかんで、その{場|ば}に{押|お}さえつけた。
examples.english: The officer grabbed the man trying to flee by the scruff of the neck and pinned him down on the spot.

notes:
Literally the area where the collar ({襟|えり}) meets the neck ({首|くび}). Most commonly appears in the phrase {襟首|えりくび}をつかむ (to grab by the scruff).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {襟首|えりくび}をつかむ (to grab by the scruff)
- {襟首|えりくび}をつかまえる (to seize by the collar)
- {襟首|えりくび}を{引|ひ}っ{張|ぱ}る (to pull by the collar)

The word evokes a forceful, physical action — often used when describing someone being restrained or dragged. In figurative usage, it can suggest being caught or cornered.
